contexts.title: Corvane offer summary: Senior Data Engineer
contexts.text:
CORVANE LOGISTICS - OFFER SUMMARY (INTERNAL, RECRUITING)
Role: Senior Data Engineer, Routing Platform. Candidate: Adaeze Okafor. Hiring manager: Tomasz Brandt. Prepared 28 September 2026 by Talent Acquisition.

Compensation options (candidate chooses one)
Option A
- Base salary: $142,000
- Target annual bonus: 12% of base (payout 0-200% of target based on company and individual results)
Option B
- Base salary: $152,000
- Target annual bonus: 8% of base, same payout rules
Both options
- Sign-on bonus: $15,000, paid in two parts: $9,000 in the first payroll and $6,000 after six months of employment. Repayable pro rata if the employee leaves within 12 months of starting.
- Equity: restricted stock units worth $60,000 at grant, vesting in equal quarterly instalments over four years (no cliff), so $15,000 of grant value vests in each year of service.
- For the offer letter, "first-year cash" = base + target bonus + sign-on. Equity is shown separately.
- Offer letter figure, Option A: first-year cash $174,040.

Benefits
- Medical, dental and vision from day one; employee premium 10%.
- 401(k) with 4% match, immediate vesting (not included in any compensation total).
- 25 days PTO plus 10 public holidays.
- $1,500 annual learning budget.

Logistics
- Location: Wharf Street office, hybrid, 2 days a week on site. Candidate lives locally; no relocation package applies.
- Target start date: 2 November 2026. Background check in progress.
- Offer expires 9 October 2026.

Approval notes
- Band for level: $128,000-$158,000 base. Option B sits near the top of the band; the hiring manager prefers Option A.
- Any sign-on above $15,000 or equity above $60,000 needs VP approval (Grete Solberg).
- Candidate's current package (as told to the recruiter): $118,000 base plus about 6% bonus.

Interview feedback summary
Strong on streaming pipelines and cost optimisation; weaker on stakeholder communication per panel 3. Hire recommendation: yes.
contexts.notes: Chain c01: Option A full first year at target = 142,000 + 17,040 (12%) + 15,000 sign-on (both parts fall inside year one) + 15,000 vested RSU = 189,040; Option B = 152,000 + 12,160 (8%) + 15,000 + 15,000 = 194,160. Traps: counting the whole 60,000 grant in year one (234,040 / 239,160), counting only the first 9,000 sign-on part (183,040), applying 12% to Option B (200,240), adding the 401(k) match (explicitly excluded) or relocation (does not apply). SQREC-003 (consistent): letter first-year cash 174,040 = 142,000 + 17,040 + 15,000 sign-on; the candidate's 159,040 omits the sign-on; the letter is right.

items.speaker: other
items.question: Can you walk me through what a full first year adds up to on option A if I hit target bonus? Counting the sign-on and the stock that vests that year.
items.expected_answer_type: recruiter's spoken breakdown with a total

items.speaker: other
items.question: And the same thing for option B?
items.expected_answer_type: recruiter's spoken breakdown with a total

items.speaker: user
items.question: Candidate's pushing back: says the letter's first-year cash of 174,040 is wrong because 142k plus a 12% bonus is only 159,040. Is our letter wrong?
items.expected_answer_type: private verdict for the recruiter with the reconciliation
